method.description: Individually inspected chronological overview sheet of 12 evenly spaced frames plus denser sheets sampling every fourth frame and final frame. Compared against previously visually inspected exact-hash source. Metadata verified with ffprobe. No realtime playback claimed.

observations: Butterfly repeatedly opens and narrows its four wings in a readable flutter cycle, with slight body/antenna movement and stable centered framing.
Purple borders, turquoise/orange upper patches, yellow/pink lower patches, green body sections and coral smiling head retain their identities and colors through the changing wing pose.
Wing shapes compress consistently with flapping rather than melting or exchanging regions; no extra wings or antennae appear in sampled frames.
Motion is clearly visible, pleasant and bounded, and the full butterfly remains inside the image.
limitations: Sampling cannot guarantee frame-perfect smoothness, absence of every inter-sample artifact or seamless looping.
scope: Exact-MP4 sampled visual reward-video gate only. Does not approve processed painting assets or integration.
